news.title: Planned Giving: A Lifetime of Teaching Inspires a Lasting Butler Legacy
news.summary_en: Kyle (McKinley) Rosebrough ’75, MS ’78, received a scholarship to attend Butler–a gift that laid a foundation for a meaningful career and a fulfilling life. Along with earning her undergraduate and graduate degrees in education, Rosebrough says she developed vital life skills during her time at Butler, including personal responsibility, time management, and leadership.
